mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rss_feed (title, site_url, feed_url, description, enabled) VALUES (#{title}, #{siteUrl}, #{feedUrl}, #{description}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE rss_feed SET title = #{title}, site_url = #{siteUrl}, feed_url = #{feedUrl}, description = #{description}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rss_feed ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM rss_feed WHERE enabled = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE rss_feed SET title = COALESCE(NULLIF(title, ''), #{fallbackTitle}), description = COALESCE(description, #{description}), last_fetched_at = #{now}, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
